theme.designMd:
# Roam travel booking app (code.in.30s)
Destination explorer + booking mobile app. Soft glassmorphism + clean minimal: frosted translucent pills over photos (backdrop blur, white 20-30% fill, thin white border), 20px radius cards, full-round pill chips and search, soft diffuse shadows, Plus Jakarta Sans, thin rounded line icons, real travel photography (mountains, beaches, lakes, old towns). NO emoji, NO serif fonts, NO illustrations.
## Light: background white #FFFFFF with a frosted pale-sky gradient wash at the top (#E6F2FD to #F4F9FF to white). Cards white with soft blue-grey shadow. Ink #101C2C, secondary text #8A94A6. ONE azure accent gradient #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF for the active chip, primary CTA and active nav icon. Tiny accents only: coral #E8573A for heart/like, gold #F5B223 for rating stars.

screens.prompt:
Mobile travel booking / destination explorer app called "Roam".
LIGHT mode aesthetic:
- Background: pure #FFFFFF with a soft frosted pale-sky gradient wash at the top (#E6F2FD fading to #F4F9FF then white).
- Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans rounded geometric sans, clean modern hierarchy, no serif. Ink color #101C2C for headings/primary text, secondary #8A94A6.
- Accents: ONE primary azure accent gradient from #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF used for the active chip, primary accents, and active bottom-nav item.
- Tiny accents only: coral #E8573A heart icon, gold #F5B223 rating star.
- Frosted translucent glass elements over photos: backdrop blur, white 20-30% fill, thin white border (border-white/40 to border-white/60).
- Roundedness: full-round pill chips, pill search bar, ~20px radius cards (rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl). Thin rounded line icons (lucide or heroicons style/material symbols). NO emojis.
- Dimensions/Layout: mobile screen sized for 390x844 viewport, comfortable breathable airy spacing.

Screen Content:
1. Top Bar / Header:
   - Left: small round avatar photo (friendly young woman traveler) next to "Hi, Aria" (font-semibold text-ink text-base) and muted subtext "Where to next?" (#8A94A6 text-xs).
   - Right: small frosted location pill with map pin icon and text "Bali, Indonesia" (subtle frosted glass border, text-xs font-medium text-ink).
2. Headline:
   - Big bold headline "Explore the\nworld" (2 lines, font-extrabold text-3xl tracking-tight text-ink mt-4 mb-3).
3. Search Bar:
   - Full-round pill search bar "Search destinations" with magnifying glass icon on the left and a round filter slider icon button on the right (frosted white bg with soft shadow).
4. Category Chips Row:
   - Horizontal scrollable pill chips:
     * "All" (ACTIVE: azure gradient #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF, white text, soft azure glow/shadow)
     * "Popular" (inactive: white bg, border border-slate-100 text-slate-500 font-medium)
     * "Recommended" (inactive)
     * "Most visited" (inactive)
5. Featured Destination Cards:
   - Horizontal row showing 2 TALL vertical destination photo cards (~200px wide, ~280px tall, rounded-[22px] overflow-hidden shadow-lg shadow-sky-950/5 relative):
     * Card 1: "Kyoto, Japan" with real beautiful photograph of Kyoto bamboo forest / pagoda.
       - Top-left: frosted glass rating pill (gold star #F5B223 + "4.8" font-semibold text-white/95 backdrop-blur-md bg-black/25 or white/30 border border-white/40 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs).
       - Top-right: frosted circular heart button with coral #E8573A heart icon (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/30 border border-white/40 rounded-full p-2).
       - Bottom overlay panel: frosted translucent glass container (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/40 dark:bg-black/40 border-t border-white/40 p-3 rounded-b-[22px]) showing "Kyoto, Japan" in bold white/ink, location pin, and "$420 / person" in crisp font.
     * Card 2: "Santorini, Greece" with stunning caldera / white cliffside architecture and blue sea photo.
       - Top-left: frosted glass rating pill (gold star #F5B223 + "4.9").
       - Top-right: frosted circular heart button.
       - Bottom overlay panel: "Santorini, Greece", location, and "$580 / person".
6. Section "Popular trips":
   - Header with section title "Popular trips" (font-bold text-lg text-ink) and "See all" text link (#3B8CF5 text-xs font-semibold).
   - One compact list row card (white background, rounded-2xl p-3 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm shadow-slate-200/50 flex items-center gap-3):
     * Left: rounded-xl image thumbnail (~64x64) of "Lake Bled, Slovenia" (emerald lake with island church).
     * Center: "Lake Bled, Slovenia" (font-bold text-sm text-ink), duration "3 days" with subtle calendar or clock icon, gold rating star "4.9 (128 reviews)".
     * Right: price "$340" (bold text-base text-ink) with small "/ person" and arrow button or book prompt.
7. Bottom Navigation Bar:
   - Floating frosted pill navigation bar (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border border-white/80 shadow-2xl shadow-sky-950/10 rounded-full px-4 py-2 flex justify-between items-center fixed bottom-5 inset-x-6 z-50):
     * "Home": Active with azure gradient pill background (#3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF), white icon & small label "Home".
     * "Explore": Inactive slate-400 icon and label "Explore".
     * "Trips": Inactive slate-400 icon and label "Trips".
     * "Profile": Inactive slate-400 icon and label "Profile".
screens.title: Roam - Home

outputComponents.text:
I've created the **Roam** mobile Home screen in light mode, designed to fit the 390×844 viewport with clean glassmorphic touches:

### Key Design Highlights
- **Palette & Atmosphere:** Soft pale-sky gradient wash at the top (`#E6F2FD` fading through `#F4F9FF` to crisp `#FFFFFF`), deep ink headings (`#101C2C`), and muted secondary text (`#8A94A6`).
- **Signature Glassmorphism:** Translucent frosted glass pills with soft backdrop blurs and subtle white borders over high-quality destination photography for ratings, location indicators, and actions.
- **Accents:** A single vibrant azure gradient (`#3B8CF5` to `#5AA7FF`) highlighting the active "All" chip and active "Home" navigation pill, paired with tiny coral (`#E8573A`) and warm gold (`#F5B223`) indicators.
- **Content Hierarchy:**
  - **Header:** User profile greetings ("Hi, Aria" / "Where to next?") alongside a quick location pill ("Bali, Indonesia").
  - **Hero Title & Search:** 2-line bold "Explore the world" heading above a full-round pill search bar with filter trigger.
  - **Horizontal Featured Cards:** Tall cards for Kyoto and Santorini with floating rating badges, save action buttons, and frosted bottom detail panels.
  - **Popular Trips:** Structured list card showcasing Lake Bled with duration, rating, and transparent pricing.
  - **Floating Dock:** Soft frosted pill bottom navigation bar with icons and labels for Home, Explore, Trips, and Profile.

screens.prompt:
Mobile travel booking / destination explorer app called "Roam". Explore screen in clean LIGHT mode: white #FFFFFF background with a soft frosted pale-sky gradient wash at the top (#E6F2FD fading to #F4F9FF then white). White cards with soft diffuse blue-grey shadows. Typography in Plus Jakarta Sans everywhere (rounded geometric sans, NO serif). Ink #101C2C, secondary slate #8A94A6.    - "Cities" (Inactive pill).
   - "Lakes" (Inactive pill).
   - "Forests" (Inactive pill).
4. Big Featured Card (Full width ~350x330, 24px rounded corners, overflow hidden, relative, high quality travel photography of Maldives tropical turquoise lagoon with overwater bungalows):

     - Top-left: frosted pill badge "Trending" with a small flame/sparkle line icon.
     - Top-right: circular frosted glass button with coral #E8573A heart icon.
     - Bottom overlay container: frosted glass panel (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/30 border border-white/40 p-4 rounded-2xl mx-3 mb-3 text-white):
       - Destination title "Maafushi Island, Maldives" with location pin.
       - Rating row: gold #F5B223 star icon, "4.9", "(2.1k reviews)" in translucent white text.
       - Price & Action row: "$899" with "/person" label, and on the right a round frosted button with arrow forward icon.
5. "Nearby escapes" Section:

6. Floating Bottom Navigation Bar:

screens.name: projects/11564962150265373680/screens/ffcacb131b194bdeb6652e0c06f48712
screens.prompt:
Create a mobile Destination Detail screen for the travel booking app "Roam" (390x844 viewport).
Theme & Style:
- LIGHT mode: white (#FFFFFF) background with soft frosted pale-sky gradient wash at top.
- Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans (rounded geometric sans, clean hierarchy).
- Colors: Ink #101C2C, secondary muted #8A94A6, azure accent gradient #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF.
- Accents: coral #E8573A heart icon, gold #F5B223 rating star.
- Frosted glassmorphism: frosted translucent glass pills over photos (backdrop-blur-md, white/25% fill, border border-white/40).
- NO emoji. Thin rounded modern icons (e.g. Material Symbols or Lucide icons). NO bottom nav on this detail screen.

Screen Layout:
1. Top Hero Section (~45% height):
   - High-quality scenic photo of Lake Brienz with turquoise water and Swiss Alps mountains, bottom corners rounded 28px (`rounded-b-[28px] overflow-hidden`).
   - Top floating actions with safe-area spacing: Frosted round back button on the top-left (circular glass pill with chevron-left), and frosted round favorite button on the top-right with coral #E8573A heart icon.
   - Overlaid at the bottom-right of the hero: a row of 3 small rounded thumbnail previews (scenic angles/chalet/lake) with frosted borders and active indicator.
   - Overlaid at the bottom-left or bottom pill: clean subtle indicator or subtle glass gradient.

2. Destination Header (Below hero on crisp white):
   - Destination title: "Lake Brienz" in bold font-extrabold text-2xl text-ink.
   - Location row: location pin icon with "Interlaken, Switzerland" in text-secondary font-medium text-sm.
   - Meta info badge row: Gold star icon with "4.9" bold and "(1.2k reviews)" in muted text, alongside a soft pale azure pill "5 days" or "All-Inclusive".

3. "Top Facilities" Section:
   - Section heading: "Top Facilities" (semibold, text-ink).
   - Horizontal row of 4 rounded-2xl icon tiles on soft pale sky backgrounds (#EBF4FF or sky-50), with subtle azure/ink icons and clean labels below:
     * Wi-Fi ("Fast Wi-Fi")
     * Dinner ("Breakfast & Dinner")
     * Pool ("Infinity Pool")
     * Hiking ("Guided Hiking")

4. "Description" Section:
   - Section heading: "About Destination" or "Description".
   - 3 lines of elegant, legible muted body text (#5A6679 or secondary): "Nestled amidst the towering Bernese Oberland peaks, Lake Brienz boasts crystalline turquoise waters fed by alpine glaciers. Experience serene boat excursions, secluded chalet stays, and breathtaking hiking trails."
   - Inline/following azure text button: "Read more" with subtle arrow or link styling.

5. Sticky Bottom Booking Bar:
   - Fixed at the bottom of the screen with a clean frosted blur and soft top border.
   - Left side: Price display: "$1,250" in bold text-2xl text-ink with "/ person" in text-xs text-secondary below or beside.
   - Right side: Eye-catching "Book Now" CTA button with the signature azure gradient (from #3B8CF5 to #5AA7FF), rounded-full, smooth shadow, bold white typography with a trailing arrow icon.
screens.title: Roam - Destination Detail

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Destination Detail** screen for **Lake Brienz** in the Roam app:

### Design Highlights
- **Hero Imagery & Glass Controls**: Scenic high-resolution photography of Lake Brienz with `rounded-b-[28px]` corners. Overlaid with frosted translucent circular actions (back navigation and coral `#E8573A` heart) and 3 rounded thumbnail previews at the bottom right.
- **Header & Meta Information**: Bold Plus Jakarta Sans typography for "Lake Brienz", an Interlaken location row with a pin icon, and pill badges showcasing the 4.9 rating (with gold star) and trip duration ("5 days").
- **Top Facilities**: 4 balanced rounded tiles on pale sky surfaces featuring clean line icons and labels: Fast Wi-Fi, Gourmet dining, Infinity Pool, and Guided Hikes.
- **Description & Sticky Booking Bar**: Muted, readable 3-line overview with an azure "Read more" toggle, anchored by a bottom sticky booking bar displaying the **$1,250 / person** rate and a prominent rounded **Book Now** button with the signature azure gradient (`#3B8CF5` to `#5AA7FF`). Bottom navigation is omitted to focus entirely on the booking conversion flow.
